set.pl: Arthur Bay settlement (P.O. in sec. 30, fractional T34N R25W, 1912 atlas), Ingallston Twp
pinev: Arthur Bay P.O. sec 30 T34N R25W (1912 Ogle atlas); cabin not located, owner dead before the plat. Pin set about 250 m inland of GNIS Arthur Bay (45.3089,-87.4357), which lies about 150 m from the shore.
1900 census had him renting in Ingallston next to the Williams households (secs 1/12 T33N R26W, ~45.274,-87.468); the 1907 death cabin was at Arthur Bay.
